Introduction to Caroline County Circuit Court

Caroline County Circuit Court is a vital component of the legal system in Caroline County, Virginia. The purpose of the Caroline County Circuit Court is to provide a fair and impartial forum for individuals to resolve legal disputes and to protect the rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and the laws of Virginia.

The Caroline County Circuit Court is responsible for handling a wide range of legal cases, including criminal cases, civil cases, juvenile cases, and probate cases. The Caroline County Circuit Court was established in 1727, making it one of the oldest courts in Virginia.
